metadata.title: Sandisk and Intel Stocks Rise as AI Trade Reignites Before Big Tech Earnings<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
The AI Trade Is Back On. Why Sandisk Stock Is Rising Before Big Tech Earnings.
The artificial intelligence trade is back in style —and it’s perfect timing, seeing as three Big Tech companies that are plowing hundreds of billions of dollars into AI are about to post earnings.
